Three Indian Sites Added to UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List

Three Indian sites have been added to the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. The announcement was made by India's Permanent Delegation to UNESCO in Paris. The newly added sites include two locations from the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and one site from Chhattisgarh. Inclusion on the tentative list is a prerequisite for future nomination to the main World Heritage List.
